compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: flows page extension plus flows-ui test additions only; replay ledger/transport, flow reads, gallery/patterns unchanged; no schema, migration, donor import, or permission change? Any changed behavior?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 6 flows-ui source tests pass; lint/typecheck clean; production build serves /flows with the replay section; graft build/check green; no mock data; live capture honestly deferred?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: unrecognized-shape fail-closed; HTTP/network failures announced; loading/empty states; navigation bounds disabled at the ends; no hardcoded credentials?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the P10-D3 playback grain: session opening/recording UI, live browser capture, rrweb client, or unrelated refactors? Is capture honestly out of scope for this surface?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: bearer token from user input only; event data renders as text (no HTML injection); no secrets; actor scoping untouched server-side with whole-session denial?
